mechanics.claim: Bel'Veth is not subject to the normal attack speed cap.
Bel'Veth's attack speed does not increase from leveling up (no per-level AS growth).
mechanics.quote: her {{sti|attack speed}} does not grow by {{sti|xp|leveling up}}

mechanics.claim: Casting any ability grants ghosting and bonus attack speed, and the duration refreshes on subsequent ability casts.
mechanics.quote: '''Bel'Veth's''' {{tip|ability}} casts grant her {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|{{as|20% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts

mechanics.claim: Lavender stacks (and their attack speed bonus) are gained permanently upon a qualifying takedown.
A monster takedown does not grant a stack if the monster was killed by an enemy instead of Bel'Veth.
mechanics.quote: ''Death in Lavender's'' {{tip|takedown}} effect will not trigger against monsters if they were slain by an enemy
